selected_evidence.summary: Shows /dev/vgdata/lvdata at 1024 MiB, mounted as XFS at /srv/data with the test payload checksum.

selected_evidence.requirement: Online growth to at least 2 GB with contents intact
selected_evidence.summary: The mount ID remained 119 throughout growth; the LV reached 2304 MiB, XFS reached 2.3 GiB, and the payload checksum remained unchanged.
Shows the loop activation service enabled and active, the UUID-based fstab entry, and the mount dependency on the activation service.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered service, mount, 2304 MiB LV, 2.3 GiB filesystem, loop device, and unchanged payload checksum.

set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '\nSERVICE='; systemctl is-active data-loop-lvm.service
printf 'MOUNT='; findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,TARGET,OPTIONS /srv/data
printf 'LV='; sudo /sbin/lvs --noheadings --units m --nosuffix -o lv_path,lv_size /dev/vgdata/lvdata | xargs
printf 'FILESYSTEM='; df -hT /srv/data | tail -1
printf 'PAYLOAD_SHA256='; sudo sha256sum /srv/data/payload.txt | awk '{print $1}'
